close_reason: Root backend packaging now waits for demanded CallableFacts/BoundaryFacts products, consumes the produced product maps for boundary reachability/callable entries/transport inventory, and 00181 asserts callable_facts product telemetry. Focused pull tests and fmt/check/clippy passed.
description:
Goal
Make CallableFacts(id) and BoundaryFacts(id) actual demanded products instead of session side effects discovered while solving some other transport shape. Backend/native consumers should request callable and boundary rows by key when they need them.

Signal
For 00181, ProductKey::CallableFacts(Kernel.+/2 callable id) is requested and produced with a direct arity-2 surface and empty boundary_ids. First-class callable fixtures request BoundaryFacts(boundary id) explicitly before callable-entry packaging. No backend/native code reconstructs callable entries by scanning bodies, types, or same-surface boundaries.

Strategy
Have transport component/local projection publish enough keyed inventory to request callable and boundary products directly. Package callable entries from those product values. Keep direct callable and first-class boundary paths distinct: unknown, any, and none must not collapse.

Removal steps
- Remove production discovery through session.callable_facts_inventory() and session.boundary_facts_inventory() before final packaging.
- Remove producers that simply return whatever side effect happened to be in the session map; producers must derive or wait for the named fact.
- Delete backend/native fallbacks that reconstruct callable entries from body/type scans or same-surface grouping.
- Delete tests that only inspect side-effect maps without requesting CallableFacts/BoundaryFacts products.

Verification
00181 callable facts product test; first-class callable boundary product test; native callable boundary regression tests; cargo test -q --lib compiler2_pull_.
title: Pull transport: promote CallableFacts and BoundaryFacts to first-class products
